name: aegis_transcript_symbols_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: AEGIS_TRANSCRIPT_SYMBOLS_20261107 — aegis-transcript-discovery attaches a transcript to a symbol only when the text names that symbol as a case-sensitive whole word or $cashtag (lib/symbol_match.py), never on an ILIKE substring ("DRS" in "cdrs"); published_at comes from youtube_transcripts.publish_date; a (symbol, title) already filed is skipped; confidence follows HOW the symbol was named (cashtag 0.75 > bare ticker 0.65), not a constant 0.55 (LQ-20261107-143).
